title: Amico, abbiamo vinto!
subtitle: Ferrando and Guglielmo: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 2

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 8, recitative after No. 25
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (fù, sù, fè, pocchi, Per Bacco as two words, s'e diportata without the accent; all' amor, ell' è, poch' ore and quest' è as two words each; Ferrando's Ah non ci ho neppur dubbio, where the libretto has Oh; the quotation marks round Pura come colomba … si serba; Guglielmo's asides in brackets).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 262–268, the recitative between No. 25 and No. 26 (97 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges; the judge recounted every barline after one reader missed a system on p. 267), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (two errors found and corrected: Guglielmo's “Cer-to” in bar 60 starts on D, and the tempo word in bar 65 is “Allegro, a tempo”). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. The circle-cross over bar 1 ends the cut that Peters marks from the end of No. 23; it is not written in the score. The strings come in at bar 63 (“senza tempo”, Ferrando's “Il mio ritratto!”) and the recitative stays accompanied to the end: “Allegro, a tempo” at bar 65, Andante at bar 79, Allegro at bar 86. It ends “attacca Nr. 26”. Playback tempo: ♩ = 100 for the recitative with continuo, then estimated tempos for the accompanied sections (♩ = 60 senza tempo, 120 Allegro, 70 Andante, 120 Allegro), fitted to Jacobs (3:45).
